bio: Nestled at the foot of a glass-fronted building, ‘Artisan Bread and Wine’ beckons you in with the promise of a simply lovely time. By day, it’s a bakery, café and wine shop, before transforming into a bistro and bar in the evening, where the modern industrial vibe gives way to intimate candlelit tables and dimmed lighting. Most notable amongst the regularly changing, affordably priced menu are the quality of the ingredients and the impressive sauces – such as a standout Pedro Ximénez reduction with the signature octopus. The wine list focuses on natural options.
